verdict.rationale: Datalab's own Pipelines feature chains processors into versioned, reusable configurations, and published agent processors can be pinned to a specific version (<id>@<version>), so versioning is documented. Pinning to an older version implies a way back, but no explicit review or rollback workflow is described. Missing for 10: documented review/diff of pipeline versions, an explicit rollback mechanism, depth on version management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Pipelines chain processors (convert, extract, segment, custom) into reusable, versioned configurations.
Chain processors into versioned, reusable configurations and deploy to production
Address it with processor=<id>, optionally pinned to a version as <id>@<version>
